en.title: Eczema & Sensitive Skin
en.who: Guests who mark eczema or dry, itchy skin: worse in winter, itchy after showers, flares after certain foods or late nights, keeps coming back, or reacts to new products. If it's breakouts, use Acne & Skin. Eczema in a child goes to a doctor first.
studyWhy: all illness starts in the gut

say: I totally get it. The itch keeps you up at night, the cream calms it down, and a few weeks later it's back in the same spot.
feel.tip: Say back what they marked, in their words. Then ask: "What usually sets it off?"

say: Honestly, I've been there. [Your story in a line or two: when it was, what it felt like, what you tried that didn't work.]
felt.tip: Your own story, or someone close to you ("my mom", "a friend from work"). No story yet? "A lot of the people I talk to say exactly the same thing." Never make one up.

say: What I learned is that the skin is a backup exit. The main way out is the gut, then the liver. When those are overloaded, whatever can't leave that way gets pushed to the skin, and that's the flare. That's why creams calm it and then it comes back: they work on the exit, not the pressure behind it.

The other half is the barrier. Think of a brick wall where the mortar is fat, and part of that fat comes from what you eat. Hot showers and strong washes strip it, and dry air pulls the water out. So you moisturise every day while the skin looks fine, not only when it flares.
So I'd start on the inside, and look after the barrier at the same time.
found.tip: Two or three sentences, then go to the map. Pick the row that matches what they marked. If they use a cream from their doctor, tell them to keep using it.

map: Worse in winter or dry air
g&h Nourish Body Lotion, every day, even when the skin looks fine
Keeps the water in before the itch starts
Itchy after showers
g&h Nourish Body Wash, lukewarm water, lotion within three minutes
Cleans without stripping a layer of barrier every day
Flares after takeout or certain foods
Probiotic and Prebiotic Fiber
Opens the main exit, the gut, so less gets pushed to the skin
Flares after late nights, drinks or stress
Liver Support; Organics Ashwagandha Capsules in the evening
Backs up the liver on its busiest weeks. No ashwagandha if pregnant, breastfeeding, or with thyroid or liver disease
Keeps coming back
Probiotic, Liver Support, Advanced Omega, alongside their prescribed cream
Gut, then liver, then barrier. Judge it over a few months, never stop a prescribed cream
Reacts to new products
Artistry Hydrating Mousse Cleanser and Advanced Omega
Fewer products, a gentle wash, a steadier barrier. Test anything new on the inner arm first
Rarely eats oily fish, or little sun in winter
Advanced Omega; Vitamin D after a doctor checks their level
The barrier is built from the fats you eat, and vitamin D drops in winter
en.ask: Based on what you told me, I'd start with the Probiotic and Prebiotic Fiber on the inside, and the g&h Nourish Body Lotion every day on the outside. Do you want to take it home tonight?
en.doctor: Skin that is weeping, crusting, hot or painful, a flare with fever, or eczema in a child? See a doctor or dermatologist first. And never stop a cream the doctor prescribed.

zh.title: 湿疹与敏感肌
zh.who: 适合在问卷里勾了湿疹、皮肤干痒，一到秋冬就发、洗完澡就痒、吃错东西或熬夜就发、好了又反复、换护肤品就过敏的客人。如果是冒痘，用「皮肤与痘痘」。孩子的湿疹，先去看医生。

say: 我特别懂。晚上痒得睡不着，擦了药膏好一点，过几个礼拜又在老地方冒出来。
feel.tip: 用对方自己的话，把问卷上勾的说回去。然后问一句：“一般是什么情况下开始发的？”

say: 说实话，我也经历过。[你的故事，一两句就好：什么时候、什么感觉、试过什么没用。]
felt.tip: 讲你自己的，或者身边人的（“我妈妈”“我一个同事”）。还没有故事？就说：“我身边很多朋友也是这样。”千万别编。

say: 我后来学到，皮肤其实是身体的“备用出口”。正门是肠道，然后是肝。这两个忙不过来，走不掉的东西就被挤到皮肤上，于是就发了。所以药膏一擦就好、一停又来，因为它管的是出口，不是里面的压力。
另一半是屏障。皮肤像一面砖墙，砖缝里的“水泥”是油脂，有一部分就是你吃进去的油砌的。热水、清洁力太强的沐浴露会把它洗掉，空气一干水分又溜走。所以要在皮肤看起来没事的时候就天天擦，不是发了才擦。
所以我会建议先从里面调，屏障同时照顾好。
found.tip: 两三句就够，然后看下面的对照表，挑跟对方勾的那一项对得上的。如果对方在用医生开的药膏，提醒他照常用。

map: 一到秋冬、空气一干就发
g&h滋养身体乳，天天擦，没发的时候也擦
趁还没痒，先把水分锁住
洗完澡就痒
g&h滋养沐浴露，水温调低，擦干后三分钟内擦身体乳
洗得干净，又不会每天洗掉一层屏障
吃外卖、吃错东西就发
益生菌、益生元纤维粉
先把正门肠道打通，挤到皮肤上的就少了
熬夜、喝酒、压力大就发
护肝片；晚上吃有机南非醉茄胶囊
肝最忙的那几周给它撑一把。怀孕、哺乳期，或有甲状腺、肝脏问题的，不吃南非醉茄
好了又反复
益生菌、护肝片、深海鱼油，医生开的药膏照常用
先肠道、再肝、最后屏障。按几个月来看，药膏千万别自己停
换个护肤品就过敏
雅姿保湿慕斯洁面、深海鱼油
护肤做减法，洗得温和，屏障养稳。新东西先在手臂内侧试几天
很少吃深海鱼，冬天晒太阳少
深海鱼油；维生素D，先请医生查一下水平
屏障是用吃进去的油脂砌的，冬天维生素D也会往下掉
zh.ask: 按你刚才说的，我建议里面先从益生菌和益生元纤维粉开始，外面每天擦g&h滋养身体乳。今天要不要先带回去？
zh.doctor: 如果皮肤渗液、结黄痂、发烫发疼，发作时还发烧，或者是孩子的湿疹，请先去看医生或皮肤科。医生开的药膏不要自己停。
